description: List every booking on the signed-in customer's own account, sorted by scheduled time, latest first. Use when an authenticated customer asks what is scheduled, or to grab an `order_id` before reschedule_booking or cancel_booking. Takes: no arguments. Returns orderId, service, status, scheduledAt, location per row (e.g. Scheduled vs Pending); fails if not signed in.
name: my_bookings

orderId.description: Pass to reschedule_booking / cancel_booking as order_id.

scheduledAt.description: Unix seconds; null for a call-me request with no time held.
